about: E304: the face remaster's knobs per model outside Nalati's camp (faces.json is theirs), driven by scripts/img2mesh/e304_faces.sh. body = the shipped file (decoded; a rigged one is stripped first), out = where the variant's files go (<dir>/faces-<variant>/<name>[.phone].glb), neck = its neck / height, the rest as face_remaster.py's flags (bust: the Hunyuan3D-2 bust from ~/ml/img2mesh/out/e304-faces/hy/<bust>.glb, its cutout projected). E339 graft fix (v2, the default): the bust is cut at its own measured neck, scaled by neck-to-top (fit box: the geometric mean with the old head's width), its neck ring blended onto the body's, fragments dropped; the old beard / collar knobs are gone.
